svg.title: Unified monitoring and alerting architecture
svg.desc: Data flows from three ingestion sources through a metric sink and audit engine, then aggregated by an Observer Lambda which reports to Slack.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the dbt global post-hook write to custom_metrics?')
sendPrompt('What do the Snowflake task INSERTs look like?')
sendPrompt('How do Lambda JSON logs get into CloudWatch?')
sendPrompt('What does the SQL rules table in the audit registry contain?')
sendPrompt('What schema does the custom_metrics Snowflake table use?')
sendPrompt('How does the Observer Lambda scan CloudWatch logs?')
sendPrompt('How does the Auditor Snowflake task loop through SQL rules?')
sendPrompt('What production data does the Auditor task query?')
sendPrompt('What does the Observer Lambda aggregate and how often does it run?')
sendPrompt('What does the aggregated Slack report contain?')
sendPrompt('What triggers a data-alerts message vs a data-metrics report?')
